# API design

- API-001 (should): An app's API style is chosen in its plan: an HTTP API with Minimal APIs by default; gRPC, SignalR, controllers or GraphQL only where a Microsoft page recommends that style for the app's scenario (API-008) or the owner asks for it by name, and the plan says which.
- API-008 (should): For new ASP.NET Core API projects, Minimal APIs are recommended; consider controller-based APIs if you need model binding extensibility, form binding support (including IFormFile), advanced validation features, application parts or the application model, or OData support. gRPC is well suited to microservices, point-to-point real-time communication, polyglot environments, network-constrained environments and inter-process communication; other frameworks are recommended over gRPC for browser-accessible APIs and for broadcast real-time communication, and SignalR is a useful framework for broadcasting.
